newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 123 of May 15, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 123 of May 15, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 661/97 of 16 April 1997 laying down detailed rules for the application of Council Regulation (EC) No 2201/96 as regards the system of quotas for processed tomato products (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 100 of 17 April 1997)

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 659/97 of 16 April 1997 laying down detailed rules for the application of Council Regulation (EC) No 2200/96 as regards intervention arrangements in the fruit and vegetables sector (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 100 of 17 April 1997)

Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EC) No 2488/96 of 20 December 1996 temporarily suspending entirely or in part the autonomous Common Customs Tariff duties on certain fishery products (1997) (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 338, 28 December 1996)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 865/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing an export tax on cereal products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 864/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 863/97 of 14 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 862/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the maximum export refunds for olive oil for the 12th partial invitation to tender under the standing invitation to tender issued by Regulation (EC) No 2081/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 861/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on olive oil
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 860/97 of 14 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 3046/92 with regard to the reporting of the value of goods
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 859/97 of 13 May 1997 establishing unit values for the determination of the customs value of certain perishable goods

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 858/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 38th partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 857/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in its unaltered state
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 856/97 of 14 May 1997 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector.
